hook: Moisant built his career on the operational spine of technology organizations, infrastructure, security, enterprise platforms, and the internal systems that keep large companies running. At Indeed, overseeing 300 million monthly visitors and three million employers, he sits at the intersection of consumer scale and enterprise risk, leading both the CIO and CSO functions simultaneously.
name: Anthony Moisant

quote.text: Transforming Business and Protecting Data with Expertise in Cybersecurity and Digital Innovation.

reading.body:
Anthony Moisant holds the CIO and CSO roles simultaneously at Indeed, a platform serving 300 million monthly visitors and three million employers, making him responsible for both the operational infrastructure and the security perimeter of one of the largest labor-market systems in the world.

That dual mandate is the defining pattern of his career. At Glassdoor he held an unusually broad portfolio that combined IT, security, privacy, compliance, legal, risk, real estate, and workplace operations under a single leader. At Indeed he carries the same CIO-CSO pairing, and his role as Executive Officer at Recruit Holdings extends that responsibility across the full HR Tech portfolio, including Glassdoor, Flex, and Indeed Recruit. The data does not indicate how those functions are staffed or budgeted beneath him, only that they are formally unified at the top.

His background connects directly to infrastructure rather than to product or revenue. Six years on nuclear submarines, followed by consulting and then media-sector IT leadership, trace a line through systems reliability, physical security, and enterprise operations before he moved into platform-scale internet companies. For AI specifically, the data covers none of that ground. There is no mention of AI infrastructure, compute procurement, or data-center strategy in his record as presented here. What the data does establish is the operational context in which those decisions would be made: a leader whose career has consistently been about keeping large, high-availability systems running and secured, at the intersection of consumer scale and enterprise risk.
